Add tests reproducing the assigned-open shape, asserting the sample bound and remedy text, and confirming --repair leaves assignment untouched. issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but specifies its decision as post-0.1 item R025 and no open bead tracks it. Add a third dependency kind `verifies` alongside `blocks` (§3.4's cycle rejection and two-kind set otherwise unchanged), letting an author declare the check relationship from the verifying bead to the verified one. Diagnose inverted verification gates structurally: report a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead. The diagnosis must be advisory — never reject the edge at insert time (a deliberate prove-baseline-green ordering is structurally identical and only the author knows), never infer the relationship from issue titles under any circumstance, and keep the lint unable to make a bead eligible or ineligible (R021 posture). Scope: schema and `bead manifest`/`bead dep` support for the new kind, checkpoint round-trip of `verifies` edges (including unknown-field-safe export), doctor/list reporting of detected inversions with declared-edge evidence, and conformance plus concurrency tests for inserting, listing, closing-through, and redacting `verifies` edges. Motivation recorded in the ADR: 21 inverted edges in one live workspace and 24 plus 7 cycles in another, arising at 4–6% of newly created beads.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the `verifies` dependency kind and structural inverted-gate diagnosis (R025, ADR-001)
